body_html:
Craft coffee and side tables are the easy way to ground a casual meeting space. Built as the perfect partner to Craft fully upholstered modular lounge seating, this square cube docking table is durable, simple to configure, and ideal for the open, flexible environments that today's offices, schools, and healthcare spaces depend on. A 1" thick thermally fused laminate surface gives teams a place to set down drinks, snacks, or personal devices during an impromptu discussion.

Features

  • Square cube docking design nests up to four round or square Craft lounge units
  • When fully nested, cubes extend 3" beyond the laminate perimeter — an open invitation to pull one out and reconfigure the space
  • 1" thick thermally fused laminate top with a 2mm matching edgeband for clean, hard-wearing edges
  • Equipped with levelers to stay steady on uneven floors
  • Helps ground the area and keeps mobile Craft cubes tidy when not in use
  • Available in all Ionic laminate finishes
  • GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold certified for low-emission indoor air quality
  • Cube seating sold separately (code MVL13012); assembly required

Specifications

Overall dimensions 35"W x 35"D x 19.5"H, weighing 78 lbs. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and backed by a 15-year warranty, with 5 years on moving and electrical parts.

A family-owned Canadian supplier since 1964, Brant Business Interiors is an OECM-eligible partner — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote below or call 1-800-835-9565 to spec your Craft lounge configuration.
